# Modernize with Temenos Core

Trusted by over 950 banks, Temenos Core Banking helps institutions rapidly scale, cut costs, and deliver innovative services that exceed customer expectations.

[Explore Core Banking](https://www.temenos.com/products/core-banking/)

![](https://www.temenos.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/header-02-scaled-1.jpg)

## The richest set of end-to-end banking capabilities

### Core Banking

Deliver innovative and comprehensive banking solutions that strengthen customer relationships, with speed and efficiency.

[Explore Core Banking](https://www.temenos.com/products/core-banking/)

### Digital Banking

Create personalized experiences, powerful transactional capabilities and efficient processes, to optimize performance and accelerate transformation.

[Explore Digital Banking](https://www.temenos.com/products/digital-banking/)

### Payments

Power payments growth with secure, real-time processing, accelerated innovation, and elevated experiences.

[Explore Payments](https://www.temenos.com/products/payments/)

### Wealth Management

Drive efficiency and sustainable growth with our advanced solution to reduce costs and power end-to-end transformation.

[Explore Wealth Management](https://www.temenos.com/products/wealth-management/)

### Financial Crime Mitigation

Detect, remediate, and report financial crime risks across KYC, sanctions, watchlists, fraud, and AML activities.

[Explore Financial Crime Mitigation](https://www.temenos.com/products/core-banking/regulatory-compliance/financial-crime-mitigation/)

## Composable Solutions

Modernize your core without unnecessary disruption, creating value faster and significantly lowering transformation risk.

[View solutions](https://www.temenos.com/temenos-composable-solutions/)

- ### Temenos Named Best-Selling Core Banking Provider for 21st Consecutive Year



GRAND-LANCY, Switzerland – June 16, 2026 – Temenos (SIX: TEMN), a global leader in banking technology, today announced it was ranked the best-selling provider in 15 categories in the 2026 IBS Intelligence Annual Sales League Table (SLT), including #1 in Core Banking for the 21st consecutive year.





![](https://www.temenos.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ibs-image-2.jpg)

GRAND-LANCY, Switzerland, June 8th, 2026 – Temenos AG (SIX: TEMN), a global leader in banking technology, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire additiv AG (“additiv”).
